name: Frost Steps
description: A quiet sliding puzzle on a frozen pond. Slide the walker until a rock or the edge stops it, and find the way to the warm lantern. Every puzzle is checked to be solvable, with a puzzle each day.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A walker stands on a square frozen pond with a few rocks. Each move sends the walker sliding in one direction until something stops it.
help.goal: Reach the warm lantern square. The lantern is warm, so the walker stops there. When you arrive the game shows the best possible number of moves. There is no timer.
howToPlay: Find the walker, a blue circle, and the lantern, an orange square. Rocks are grey stones.
Choose a direction. The walker slides straight until the next square is a rock or the edge of the pond, or until it reaches the lantern.
Plan where each slide ends, since the walker cannot stop in the middle of the ice.
Every puzzle can be solved. Today's puzzle is the same for everyone today and remembers your fewest moves. New puzzle gives a fresh one. Restart goes back to the start, and Undo takes back a slide.

controls.keys: Arrow keys or W A S D
controls.action: Slide the walker in that direction
Slide toward it, when it is in the walker's row or column
Reach the slide buttons, Undo, Restart and the puzzle buttons

tips: Work backwards from the lantern: which squares can reach it in one slide?
A rock one square beyond a spot is a good place to stop.
Slides that go nowhere do not count as moves.
You can stop at any time. Your puzzle and undo history are saved.
